Name: Target search range scale
Description: Scales normal target acquisition. Increasing it above 1 also expands the automatic selector's vertical limits. Applying it recalculates the break distance from the loaded default. Some native target categories bypass distance tests at scales of 1 or more.
RestoreBehavior: Applied once. Scripts or scene initialization can replace these runtime values. Reset targeting ranges reads current native defaults; disconnect leaves one-time edits applied.

Evidence.Finding: The native scale setter stores a float and recalculates retention distance using system parameters+80. Acquisition reads parameters+76; retention is a separate global float. The trainer reproduces these scalar writes after resource and actor validation.
Evidence.Level: Complete native ASM, original setter bytes and synthetic ownership/bounds tests. No live gameplay validation. Edit bounds are trainer policy.
